text: The Duplo Aliens The Duplo Aliens ( voiced by Sawyer Jones , Liam Knight , Cora Miller , Graham Miller , Emmett Mitchell , and Ollie Mitchell ) are a race of giant aliens made of Duplo blocks that come from the planet Duplo .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: As a result of " The Man Upstairs " allowing his younger daughter Bianca to play with him and Finn , the Duplo Aliens arrive with the lead Duplo Alien announcing their plans to destroy everyone before the film ends in a cliffhanger .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: In the second film , the Duplo Aliens ' attack turned Bricksburg into Apocalypseburg .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: However , it is also revealed in the second film is that they only wanted to join Bricksburg but had communication problems .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: In addition , their planet is located below the planet where Harmony Town is .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: In the second films sets and videogame , they are made out of Lego parts to resemble Duplo rather than the actual product .

text: Their feud caused their mom to order them to put away the bricks , which brought " Armamageddon " to the Lego Universe .

text: After Rex Dangervest was defeated , Finn and Bianca make up and made a compromise to combine Apocalypseburg and the Systar System , which pleases their mother .

text: Batman Rogues ' Gallery

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: There are different villains in Gotham City that Batman fights .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Some of the villains are :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Joker The Joker ( voiced by Zach Galifianakis in The Lego Batman Movie , André Sogliuzzo in Lego Dimensions ) is the " Clown Prince of Crime " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He wants to make Batman admit that he is his greatest enemy .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: His latest scheme to rule Gotham City was to team up with Batman 's gallery of villains and threaten to bomb the nuclear power plant , which would sink Gotham into the Infinite Abyss of Nothingness .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: But as that plan was foiled by the Caped Crusader , he now wants to release the Phantom Zone 's greatest criminals in the universe to take over the city .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Harley Quinn Harleen Quinzel / Harley Quinn ( voiced by Jenny Slate in The Lego Batman Movie , Margot Rubin in The Lego Movie 2 : The Second Part , Tara Strong in Lego Dimensions ) is Joker 's partner in crime and girlfriend who will help him whenever he has a plan .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: She appears in The Lego Movie 2 : The Second Part where she is listed as a Master Builder .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Her appearance is similar to the depiction of Harley Quinn that is seen in Suicide Squad .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: When Emmet is looking for help to rescue his friends from General Sweet Mayhem , Harley Quinn stated that any plans to rescue them from the aliens would be a " suicide mission . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Penguin Oswald Cobblepot / The Penguin ( voiced by John Venzon ) is a tuxedo - wearing supervillain that uses trick umbrellas and robotic penguins .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: His sickly appearance , outfit ( mainly the spotted tie and fluffy coat ) , sharp teeth and army of weaponized penguins are based on Danny DeVito 's depiction of the character in Batman Returns .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Riddler Edward Nygma / The Riddler ( voiced by Conan O'Brien in The Lego Batman Movie , Roger Craig Smith in Lego Dimensions ) is a supervillain who is obsessed with riddles .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He was one of the villains invading the Gotham Energy facility .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: While he was on the road , Riddler placed a giant question mark in front of an unsuspecting driver called Jeff .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: After Jeff stopped his car , Riddler tore his left arm off with his cane , leaving the car to be hit by a truck that Captain Boomerang and Two - Face had hijacked .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He later invades Commissioner Gordon 's retirement party with the other villains , but Joker has them all surrender to the police .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Confused , Riddler asks " Riddle me this , what just happened ? "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He later breaks out of Arkham Asylum and teams up with Batman to save the city from the Phantom Zone inmates that Joker released and keep Gotham City from coming apart over the void .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Catwoman Selina Kyle / Catwoman ( voiced by Zoë Kravitz in The Lego Batman Movie , Grey Griffin in Lego Dimensions ) is a cat - themed cat burglar .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Two - Face Harvey Dent / Two - Face ( voiced by Billy Dee Williams in The Lego Batman Movie , Imari Williams in Lego Dimensions ) is a disfigured supervillain with a split personality who makes decisions by flipping a double - sided coin .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: This version of Two - Face is based on Williams ' depiction of the character from Batman .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Scarecrow Jonathan Crane / Scarecrow ( voiced by Jason Mantzoukas ) is a scarecrow - themed supervillain who specializes in fear toxins .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: At the start of the attack on the Gotham Energy facility where Joker was placing a bomb there , Scarecrow breathed fear gas onto a gate guard while posing as a pizza deliveryman .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He is defeated by Batman and escape alongside the others .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: In the following day , Scarecrow invades the city 's winter gala party with the rest of Gotham 's villains .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He and the rest of them are apprehended by the police when Joker persuaded them to surrender .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Later , along with the other city 's villains , Scarecrow is recruited by Batman and his allies to work together to send back the escaped villains into the Phantom Zone and save Gotham City .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Once Gotham is saved , Batman allows Scarecrow and the rest of his rogues gallery to escape .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Phantom Zone Inmates

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: In the Lego universe , the Phantom Zone is used to imprison the most dangerous villains of the Lego universe with some of the DC Comics ones being the major ones .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Phantom Zone inmates that Joker allies with have been sorted in the cast list as " The Ubers . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Besides a Swamp Creature and Medusa , among the known inmates are :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Agent Smith Agent Smith ( voiced by Christopher Corey Smith in Lego Dimensions ) is a program turned virus from The Matrix franchise , he is accompanied by his horde of duplicates that he assimilated into his likeness .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Bruce Bruce is the man-eating great white shark from Jaws .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Daleks are a race of robotic aliens from Doctor Who who are bent on exterimenting all life to become " the supreme beings " of the universe .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Although they are depicted with the brilliant colours of the 2010 New Paradigm Daleks ) , their shapes seem to resemble those of the classic 1963 Daleks .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: King Kong King Kong ( voiced by Seth Green ) is a giant gorilla that comes from Skull Island that has a habit of climbing tall buildings .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: During Joker 's campaign to take over Gotham City , King Kong destroys one of the skyscrapers that Batman and the others hide in .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: King Kong is later defeated and sent back to the Phantom Zone .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: During the attack on Gotham City , the Kraken tries to shoot down the Batwing and accidentally hits Sauron .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Lloyd Lloyd Garmadon / Green Ninja ( voiced by Dave Franco ) is the main character and protagonist of The Lego Ninjago Movie .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He is the leader of the Secret Ninja Force who goes under the alias The Green Ninja .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: Kai Kai / Fire Ninja ( voiced by Michael Peña ) is the outgoing and enthusiastic Red Ninja of Fire .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: He is fiercely loyal to his fellow ninjas , particularly Lloyd and his sister Nya .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: His vehicle is a humanoid mech with flamethrower arms known as the Fire Mech .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: His vehicle is a mech supported by one wheel and armed with powerful weaponized speakers known as the Quake Mech .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Lego Movie franchise

text: The Loud House is an American sitcom multimedia franchise based on creator Chris Savino 's own experiences with his large family .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The franchise includes the television series The Loud House ( 2016 – present ) , its spin - off series The Casagrandes ( 2019 – 2022 ) , the films The Loud House Movie ( 2021 ) , A Loud House Christmas ( 2021 ) , A Really Haunted Loud House ( 2023 ) , The Casagrandes Movie ( 2024 ) , No Time to Spy ( 2024 ) , and A Loud House Christmas Movie : Naughty or Nice ( 2025 ) , and the live - action spin - off The Really Loud House ( 2022 – 2024 ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Loud House , The Casagrandes , and ancillary media , including spin - offs , movies , and books , are set in the town of Royal Woods , Michigan , and the city of Great Lakes City .

text: Lincoln Albert Loud ( voiced by Sean Ryan Fox in 2014 , Grant Palmer in 2016 , Collin Dean in 2016 – 2018 , singing voice by Jackson Petty in " Really Loud Music " , Tex Hammond in 2018 – 2020 , Asher Bishop in 2020 – 2022 , Bentley Griffin in 2022 – 2024 , Sawyer Cole in 2023 – 2025 , Nick A. Fisher in 2025 – present ) , portrayed by Wolfgang Schaeffer in A Loud House Christmas , The Really Loud House , and A Really Haunted Loud House , Justin Allan as a young boy in The Really Loud House ) is an 11 - year - old boy ( 12 - year - old season 6 onward and live - action media ) with white hair who is the middle child and the only son in the Loud family .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The character got his name from E Lincoln Avenue in Royal Oak , where the show 's creator Chris Savino grew up .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln has a passion for comic books , especially his favorite superhero Ace Savvy who has a playing card theme as well as secret agent David Steele .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Alongside his little sister Lisa , Lincoln is the family nerd .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is also , however , the primary leader of his ten sisters , as he typically plans schemes , strategies , and " operations " for better convenience , as well as to help others , that the girls more often than not follow .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln has other talents , including cooking , playing video games , performing magic tricks , and coaching his younger sister Lola to prepare her for her pageants .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln wears an orange polo shirt , blue jeans , gray socks , and white sneakers .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln often breaks the fourth wall by talking to the audience about living with all of his sisters , and considers himself the " Man with a Plan . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He tries to give helpful advice concerning sibling relationships .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: For the first four seasons , Lincoln attends Royal Woods Elementary School with his younger sisters Lucy , Lana , Lola , and Lisa and is a 5th grader there .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " The Loudest Thanksgiving " , it is revealed that Lincoln is vulnerable to tryptophan , which causes him to fall asleep before Thanksgiving dessert is served .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Schooled ! " , Lincoln starts attending Royal Woods Middle School and transitions to 6th grade , attending school with his older sister Lynn .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Luna Loud ( voiced by Nika Futterman , portrayed by Sophia Woodward in A Loud House Christmas , The Really Loud House , and A Really Haunted Loud House , Ava Torres as a young girl in The Really Loud House ) is the 15 - year - old ( 16 - year - old from season 5 onward and live - action media ) the third child of the Loud family and Luan 's roommate .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is named after a pet dachshund Chris Savino 's mother - in - law owned .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She wears a purple shirt with a skull , a lavender skirt , a white belt , purple - tipped socks , high purple boots , black paperclip earrings , three bracelets , and a choker .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Luna is a wild and upbeat musician who owns and plays various instruments ; her signature instrument is a purple Dean ML electric guitar .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her passion for music has some negative effects , as in the episode " For Bros About to Rock " it is revealed that she unintentionally " ruined " her siblings ' first concerts .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Along with Leni , Luna has the best older sister relationship with Lincoln .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episodes " Study Muffin " and " L is for Love " revealed that Luna is bisexual , because she is attracted both to Lincoln 's male tutor Hugh and a female classmate named Sam Sharp .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Luna 's siblings are aware that Sam is female , and are supportive of Luna 's crush on her .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As of the episode " Racing Hearts " , Luna and Sam are officially dating .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Both of them formed the band Moon Goats with their friends , who made up most of the music club .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In the episode " Dad Reputation " , Luna joins her father 's band , The Doo-Dads , as its guitar player .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Luna is a sophomore at Royal Woods High School for the first four seasons and attends school with her sisters Lori , Leni and Luan .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: However , as of " Schooled ! " , she is a junior and attends school with Leni and Luan .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: According to an interview , she was Chris Savino 's favorite character in the series .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: EW writer Nick Romano interview with Michael Rubiner , the showrunner of the series who he plans to continue the arc of Luna but he does n't have any end point in mind for the two of them but " with 10 girls in the family " , he felt natural " to explore one of them being LGBTQ . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Kevin Sullivan , the writer of the series told Insider that he was n't barred from using the word " lesbian " in dialogue when writing the storyline for Luna and her crush Sam and said that " we just ca n't say those words because of how young our audience can skew but the joy of the episode , that I was proud of was that it was n't an coming out episode .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The entire family accepted her , there was no having to come out . "

text: Luan Loud Luan L. source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lynn Loud Jr. Lynn L. Loud Jr. ( voiced by Jessica DiCicco , portrayed by Morgan McGill in A Loud House Christmas , Annaka Fourneret in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House , Aria Jade Tyler as a toddler in The Really Loud House , Nyomei Valentina Lara as a young girl in The Really Loud House ) is the 13 - year - old ( 14 - year - old from season 5 onward and live - action media ) athletic fifth child of the Loud family and Lucy 's roommate .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lisa often uses formal and detailed terms to refer to basic things before saying them in layman 's terms .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She often tends to be quite reckless and unethical with her experiments but is ultimately a good - hearted girl .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is also a fan of west coast rap music and is very good at breakdancing .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Despite her intellect , Lisa struggles greatly with simple things such as arts and crafts because of her stubby fingers and also struggles to form friendships with her peers .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: After Lincoln , Lori , and Lance 's daughter Shelby got stuck on a sheet of cracking ice on Lake Mastodon , the two brothers decided to put aside their rivalry to help their children .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rita Loud Rita Loud ( voiced by Jill Talley , portrayed by Muretta Moss in A Loud House Christmas , Jolie Jenkins in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House ) is the mother of the Loud children .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her complete face is unseen until the second - season episode " 11 Louds a Leapin ' " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rita deeply cares about her children , but she is not afraid to punish them if their fighting grows too extreme .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rita wears a dark pink buttoned shirt , purple pants , white earrings , and black flats .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: It is revealed in the episodes " Cover Girls " and " L is for Love " that she met Lynn Sr. when she was working as a crossing guard .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rita 's family includes her father Albert , from whom she learned how to drive a plane and a tank .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She also has one aunt named Ruth .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rita works as a dental assistant under the dentist Dr. Feinstein , though she is working to become an author .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Write and Wrong " , Rita is hired at the Royal Woods Gazette as an advice columnist .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Really Loud House episode " What 's a Mother to Redo " reveals that Rita is allergic to strawberries .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The live - action series episode " Get Out of Dodgeball " also reveals that her last name before her marriage was Reynolds .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Other Loud family members

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Leonard Loud Leonard Loud ( voiced by Rick Zieff ) is Lynn Sr. and Lance 's father , Rita and Sharon Loud 's father - in - law , and the children 's paternal grandfather who was mentioned by Lynn Sr. in " Vantastic Voyage " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is often called " Gramps " by his grandchildren .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Like his son , Leonardo tends to cry a lot .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While originally designed to look like a hippie in a flashback seen in " Vantastic Voyage " , he was later redesigned in his official debut in " Camped ! " where he resembled Lynn Sr. with a longer beard .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Leonard was originally a traveling fisherman as seen in " Camped ! " until he got word from his son when Camp Mastodon was closing .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When the treasure was found and he used his boat to save his family , Leonard offered to use the treasure to keep Camp Mastodon open as its new proprietor so that he can be closer to his family .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Present Danger " , it is revealed that Leonard is a fan of David Steele .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Bummer Camp " , Leonard learns how to be a camper from his grandchildren .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Be Careful What You Fish For " revealed that Gramps lost the big toe on his right foot 30 years ago during an attack by the great white sturgeon Moby Rick who also wrecked the ship that he was on .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lynn commented that the loss of his big toe is why he wears socks and sandals .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lance Loud Lance Loud ( voiced by Rob Riggle ) is Lynn Sr. 's athletic brother , Rita Loud 's brother - in - law , and the children 's paternal uncle who lives out in Petoskey Falls , Michigan where he is the proprietor of the Endur - Lance Gym .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: However , there are things he ca n't do because of his muscle mass like ziplining and swimming .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is first mentioned in " Home of the Fave " and made his first physical appearance in " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Compared to his brother Lynn , Lance has a rather muscly build .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has a wife named Sharon and raises three children : eldest son Shane , middle daughter Shelby , and youngest son Shiloh .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Home of the Fave " , Lance was mentioned to be the favorite son of Leonard and during a family Christmas gathering , an accident would drive them apart .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: During " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " , Lincoln along with his sisters would devise a plan to reunite his father with his brother at Camp Mastodon .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Eventually , Lynn Sr. and Lance reconciled after working together to save Lincoln , Lori , and Shelby who were stranded on a swiftly - cracking sheet of ice at Lake Mastodon .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " One False Move " , Uncle Lance moves his family to Royal Woods to be closer to the Endur - Lance Gym as they move in to the house on the same street as their relatives .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sharon Loud Sharon Loud ( voiced by Ozioma Akagha ) is an African - American woman who is Lance 's wife , Lynn Sr. and Rita Loud 's sister - in - law , and the children 's paternal aunt .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is an expert at yoga and meditation .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sharon makes her first appearance in " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " where she was shown to be close with Rita .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When her husband Lance got enraged when he saw his brother Lynn , Sharon taught him a method to stay calm which he eventually took into heart later in the episode .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Shane Loud Shane Loud ( voiced by Christopher Livingston ) is the oldest son of Lance and Sharon and the children 's paternal cousin .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He makes his first appearance in " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Like Luna , he is into singing and is able to do a cappella .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Shelby Loud Shelby Loud ( voiced by Kyrie McAlpin ) is the bespectacled middle child of Lance and Sharon and the children 's paternal cousin .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She makes her first appearance in " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Like Lincoln , she is the only daughter in the family and can be silly at times .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When brainstorming , Shelby tends to twirl around the room .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is shown to have a bad sense of direction .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Shiloh Loud Shiloh Loud ( voiced by Bahia Watson ) is a 6 - year - old child who is the youngest child of Lance and Sharon and the children 's paternal cousin .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He makes his first appearance in " ' Twas the Fight Before Christmas " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Shiloh is known to do cannonballs into any physical object and can lift objects much larger and heavier than he is .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Albert Reynolds Albert Reynolds ( voiced by Fred Willard in 2016 – 2019 , Christopher Swindle in " Resident Upheaval " , Piotr Michael in 2021 – present , portrayed by Bill Southworth in A Loud House Christmas ) is the children 's maternal grandfather , Lynn Loud Sr. 's father - in - law , Rita 's father , and Ruth 's brother .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is often called " Pop - Pop " by his grandchildren .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: It is revealed in the series that he was a former member of the United States military until his retirement .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Albert wears a white button - up shirt , blue jean overalls with orange suspenders , a black belt , and white sneakers .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has a good relationship with his daughter and is very close to Lincoln , with whom he shares the same hair color and hairstyle .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While it was revealed in " Cover Girls " that Albert is near - sighted , this is never brought up again in later episodes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Starting in " The Old and the Restless " , Albert moved into Sunset Canyon Retirement Home where his old friends live .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Pop Pop the Question " , he proposes to Myrtle , and they are officially married in No Time to Spy : A Loud House Movie .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Myrtle Myrtle ( voiced by Jennifer Coolidge in 2018 – 2022 , Alex Cazares from 2024 onwards ) is the girlfriend of Albert .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Because she traveled extensively in her youth prior to meeting Albert , Myrtle never married or had children of her own .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When she became Albert 's girlfriend , she started to treat the Loud children as her own grandchildren .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Upon accepting her , the children started to call her " Gran - Gran " as she had wanted them to call her .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Resident Upheaval " reveals that Myrtle does not live at Sunset Canyon Retirement Home and only visits Albert there .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: By the end of the episode , Myrtle moves into Sunset Canyon Retirement Home with Gayle as a roommate .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Pop Pop the Question " , Myrtle proposes to Albert while officially becoming the Loud children 's official step - grandmother .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: It is also revealed that when she was younger , she was a secret agent who was in fake marriages with her partners as part of her cover on different missions .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her skills do help Lincoln perfect his spy tumbling .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The film No Time to Spy shows her marriage to Albert and revealed that her spy code - name is Agent 28 .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Ruth Ruth ( voiced by Grey DeLisle ) is Albert 's sister , Lynn Loud Sr. 's aunt - in - law , Rita 's paternal aunt , and the Loud children 's maternal great - aunt .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is depicted as a cat lady with a distasteful attitude because she makes the children eat old pudding and watch her cats when the Loud family visits .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She wears an olive green dress with flowers on it and white shoes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Ruth is also shown to have a sixth toe on her left foot which creeps out even Lynn Sr. Only Rita , Lana , and later Lily are the ones who can tolerate visiting her .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: 1600s ' ancestors

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The ancestors of the Loud family from the 1600s , shown in The Loud House Movie , were driven away from their town of Loch Loud by Aggie using a magic stone on Lolo the Dragon .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While Lucille first appears as a ghost in the film , the rest of them appear in ghost form at the end of the film to praise Angus for taking on the responsibility as the new Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Duke of Loch Loud ( voiced by Asher Bishop ) is the unnamed ancestor of the Louds , who looked like Lincoln , and was known for his noble deeds around Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Following Morag 's defeat , the ghost of the Duke and his family deem Angus a worthy successor of Lincoln as the new Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lucille Loud ( voiced by Katy Townsend ) is an ancestor of the Louds , looking like Lucy , and being one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She serves as a witness chronicling the Loud family 's past after being summoned into the present by Lucy in ghost form .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is also the only distant ancestor of the family whose name has been revealed .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The rest of the ancestors who appear have not been named .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: They include :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lori look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who wears a sleeveless dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Leni look - alike 1600s ' ancestor ( voiced by Liliana Mumy ) who sports braids and wore a blue tartan dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was known for her fashion skills in Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Luna look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who wears a purple cloak and a blue tartan dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was known for her musical skills in Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Luan look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who sports a braided hair and wears a jester hat and a blue tartan dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was known for her wisecrackery in Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lynn Jr. look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who sports a blue tartan skirt , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was known for her athletic abilities in Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lana look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who sports an orange hat and a dark grey skirt whose hair is in two braids , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lola look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who sports a large gold crown and a tan Victorian dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lisa look - alike 1600s ' ancestor ( voiced by Lara Jill Miller ) who wears a black Victorian dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She has the same intelligence as Lisa and has her own laboratory at Loud Castle as seen when her ghost noted that she missed her laboratory .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lily look - alike 1600s ' ancestor who wears a lacy blue tartan dress , and one of the sisters of the Duke of Loch Loud .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Rita look - alike 1600s ' ancestor ( voiced by Jill Talley ) who wears a pink and white ballgown , and the mother of the Duke of Loch Loud and his sisters .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A Lynn Sr. look - alike 1600s ' ancestor ( voiced by Brian Stepanek ) who has a full head of hair and wears a brown jacket and a kilt , and the father of the Duke of Loch Loud and his sisters .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Like his descendant , he can quote " ding dang " during his frustrations .

text: Loud family pets The Loud family has different pets in their house who usually show the same emotions as the children on different occasions .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The main family pets include :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Charles ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is a black and white Miniature Bull Terrier who has freckles and black concentric circles on his back and left eye .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Charles is usually seen sleeping in Lincoln 's room .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Cliff ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is a black - furred domestic short - haired cat with a large black nose and small ears .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Geo ( vocal effects provided by Audrey Wasilewski ) is a hamster who travels in a hamster ball .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Walt ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is a yellow canary who often has an angry expression on his face and is strong enough to lift Lily .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Loud siblings also have their own pets :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He helps her out in times of need .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Bitey is Lana 's pet rat .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Izzy is Lana 's pet lizard .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: El Diablo is Lana 's pet snake .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Duncan is Lana 's pet opossum .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Gary is Luan 's pet rabbit .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Fangs is Lucy 's pet vampire bat .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Fangs often joins Lucy in some of her activities .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lisa 's robots Lisa Loud has made an assortment of robots in order of appearance :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Mr. Reinforced Titanium Alloy Arms ( voiced by Jeff Bennett ) is a robot that was created by Lisa who sports a mailbox - like torso and tank treads for feet .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Todd ( voiced by Brian Stepanek in all media ) is a robot that was created by Lisa from different devices .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has a bucket for a head , a calculator on his forehead , a corkscrew neck , a printer for a chest ( it was substituted with a Nintendo Entertainment System in The Really Loud House ) , building toy arms where a magnet serves as a left hand and a pair of scissors serve as a right hand , a sound amplifier lower body , a fire extinguisher on his back , and different bicycle wheels instead of feet .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Todd would sometimes assist Lisa in her projects and is also programmed to understand every known human language enough to translate them .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The McBride family

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Clyde McBride Clyde McBride ( voiced by Caleel Harris in 2016 – 2018 , Andre Robinson in 2018 – 2022 , portrayed and voiced by Jahzir Bruno in 2021 – 2024 , A Loud House Christmas , The Really Loud House , and A Really Haunted Loud House , Levi Mynatt as a 9 - year - old in The Really Loud House , voiced by Jaeden White in 2022 – 2026 , Juliano Krue Valdi in 2025 – present ) is an 11 - year - old boy ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) who is best friends with Lincoln .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He owns a walkie - talkie that he uses on " missions " with Lincoln and is usually up - to - date on code words used when conveying messages .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Clyde and Lincoln share many interests , such as video games and science fiction movies .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He used to have an unrequited crush on Lori and tended to have nosebleeds , faint whenever he saw her , and / or he acts like a malfunctioned robot .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He wears circular glasses , a yellow and blue striped sweater , black pants , and black tennis shoes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When Lincoln cosplays as Ace Savvy , Clyde dresses as Ace 's sidekick One - Eyed Jack .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Clyde is a 5th grader at Royal Woods Elementary School until " Schooled ! " when he begins attending Royal Woods Middle School as a 6th - grader .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is also an accomplished pastry chef and baker .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Howard McBride

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Howard McBride ( voiced by Michael McDonald , portrayed by Justin Michael Stevenson in A Loud House Christmas , Stephen Guarino in The Really Loud House ) is Clyde 's overprotective red-haired white father , who cares deeply about his son 's well - being .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While showering Clyde with attention , Howard rarely lets him do anything unsupervised as he becomes overemotional while watching his son grow up .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Both Harold and Howard wear brown slacks , a pair of jeans , white sneakers , brown loafer shoes , a red collared shirt , a blue / teal sweater vest , a black bow tie , and a light blue shirt .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The McBrides , who are an interracial couple , are the first married gay couple to be featured in a Nickelodeon animated series .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Harold McBride

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Harold McBride ( voiced by Wayne Brady in 2016 – 2022 , Khary Payton in 2022 – present , portrayed by Marcus Folmar in A Loud House Christmas , Ray Ford in The Really Loud House ) is Clyde 's overprotective African - American father , and the son of Gayle , who cares deeply about their son 's well - being .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While showering Clyde with attention along with Howard , they rarely let him do anything unsupervised .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Both Howard and Harold wear brown slacks , a pair of jeans , white sneakers , brown loafer shoes , a red collared shirt , a blue / teal sweater vest , a black bow tie , and a light blue shirt .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The McBrides , who are an interracial couple , are the first married gay couple to be featured in a Nickelodeon animated series .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In the episode " Dad Reputation " , Harold joins Lynn Loud Sr. 's group The Doo-Dads , and plays the accordion .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Gayle McBride Gayle McBride ( voiced by Loretta Devine , portrayed by Gail Everett - Smith in A Loud House Christmas ) is the mother of Harold , the mother - in - law of Howard and the adoptive grandmother of Clyde .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was mentioned a lot in the series before showing up in person in the episode " Resident Upheaval " where she was up against Myrtle for an available room in Sunset Canyon Retirement Home , sparking a competition between Lincoln and Clyde to see whose grandmother will move in .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: By the end of the episode , Gayle gets a double room while gaining Myrtle as her roommate .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: McBride family pets Cleopawtra ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is the McBride family 's orange cat .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her name is a pun on " Cleopatra . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Nepurrtiti ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is a lavender kitten that was obtained by the McBrides in " Baby Steps " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her name is a pun on " Nefertiti . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Casagrande family The Casagrandes are a Mexican American family of characters who are the extended family of the Santiagos .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: While the Casagrandes appear in multiple episodes of The Loud House , they later gained their own spin - off show .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: It is revealed in both shows that the Casagrandes live in fictional Great Lakes City which is three hours away from Royal Woods and in a neighboring state .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: They hate cats due to having encountered swarms of cats in the city .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Ronnie Anne Santiago Ronalda " Ronnie " Anne Santiago ( voiced by Breanna Yde in 2016 – 2018 of The Loud House , Izabella Alvarez in 2019 – present of The Loud House and The Casagrandes ) is the 11 - year - old ( 12 as of The Casagrandes Movie ) sister of Bobby , a tough tomboy who enjoys skateboarding , playing video games , and pranks .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She wears a purple zipper hoodie , jean shorts , a white tank top underneath her hoodie ( in " City Slickers " and " No Show ! with the Casagrandes " ) , pink knee - high socks , and purple shoes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Originally depicted as a classmate who would annoy Lincoln with embarrassing pranks , Ronnie Anne eventually becomes one of Lincoln 's best friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A running gag is that one member of either her or Lincoln 's family refers to one of them as the other 's boyfriend / girlfriend which they both instantly deny .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: However , it is implied multiple times throughout the first seasons of The Loud House and some of the graphic novels that they harbor feelings for each other .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Bobby Santiago Roberto Alejandro Martínez - Millán Luis " Bobby " Santiago Jr. ( voiced by Carlos PenaVega , portrayed by Matt Van Smith in A Loud House Christmas , Damian Alonso in The Really Loud House ) is a 17 - year - old ( 18 - year - old season 5 onward ) boy who is Lori 's boyfriend and the older brother of Ronnie Anne .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He wears a cream T - shirt , a green jacket , blue jeans , a black and yellow belt , and brown shoes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Bobby does a lot of odd jobs in Royal Woods .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Save the Date " , it is shown that Bobby will retaliate if his sister Ronnie Anne is offended , even if it means breaking up with Lori ( to that point he immediately regrets doing it ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Although he and his family moved away to live with the Casagrande family in Great Lakes City in " The Loudest Mission : Relative Chaos " , Bobby and Lori managed to find a way to make their relationship work .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Originally working in the Casagrande family bodega as a cashier and stockboy , Bobby developed a tendency to become trapped in the dairy freezer , as seen in " City Slickers " and " The Spies Who Loved Me " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Movers and Fakers " , Bobby moves into his own apartment in the same building to get his own space after a former tenant moves to France .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Cupid 's Harrow " , Bobby and Lori separate when Bobby is offered to run a satellite version of Hector 's mercado in Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Living the Dream Boat " , Bobby enlists Lincoln to get him on The Dream Boat where he poses as a taxidermy from Portland , Oregon named Jeremy .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He fails when Lori picks Jett from Aspen .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: After the cruise where Lori learns that Jett wants her to move away from her family and gets Jeremy 's address , Lori learns about Bobby 's plot from the real Jeremy and Lincoln causing her to go to Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: They end up getting getting back together with both families present .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Maria Santiago Maria Santiago ( voiced by Sumalee Montano ) is Ronnie Anne and Bobby 's mother , Carlos ' sister , and Rosa and Hector 's daughter .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She works as a nurse at a local hospital .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: When the Santiago 's move to Great Lakes City , Maria works at the local hospital as an emergency room nurse .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In at least two episodes so far , she is shown to have childish arguments with her brother Carlos .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Arturo Santiago Dr. Arturo Santiago ( voiced by Eugenio Derbez , understudied by Fabio Tassone in The Loud House episode " Day of the Dad " and The Casagrandes Movie ) is Bobby and Ronnie Anne 's father who works as a doctor at Physicians with Missions who have their headquarters in Great Lakes City .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is currently operating in Peru where he helped to build a hospital .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Arturo 's work is liked by Carlos Casagrande and Hector Casagrande develops a scowling look when around him implying that he was not pleased with Maria and Arturo 's divorce .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Operation Dad " , Arturo visits Great Lakes City for a conference causing Ronnie Anne to find a way to make him move in after roughing it for some time .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: After some attempts fail , Ronnie Anne was able to see him off .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Upon looking at the scrapbook she left him , Arturo contacts his boss at Physician Without Missions to let him work at Great Lakes City 's Physicians Without Missions HQ while another doctor covers for him .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Teacher 's Fret " it 's revealed that he dated Ronnie Anne 's teacher , Mrs. Gina Galiano but they broke up due to their differences .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rosa Casagrande Rosa Casagrande ( voiced by Sonia Manzano ) is Ronnie Anne and Bobby 's grandmother , Maria and Carlos ' mother , and Lupe and Lazaro 's daughter .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is the matriarch of the Casagrande family and the building manager of their apartment building .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rosa is a skilled cook and uses a variety of home remedies to heal people and ward off spirits .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " 15 Candles " , it is revealed that Rosa was unable to have a Quinceañera when she was young .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Hector Casagrande Hector Rodrigo Casagrande Gutiérrez ( voiced by Ruben Garfias ) is Ronnie Anne and Bobby 's grandfather and Maria and Carlos ' father .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is the patriarch of the Casagrande family and the proprietor of the Casagrande Mercado on the ground floor of the family 's apartment building .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Hector is gossipy and knows how to play the guitar while also having his own band .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Battle of the Grandpas " , it is revealed that Hector used to be a bull rider in his youth .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlos Casagrande Carlos Casagrande Sr. ( voiced by Carlos Alazraqui ) is Ronnie Anne and Bobby 's uncle , Maria 's brother , and Rosa and Hector 's son .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is a high - spirited and sensitive father of four and works as a professor at Chavez University .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlos reads many books and can dispense rather inane trivia .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Going Overboard " , it was revealed that he was a popular skater in college named Carlos X .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He had to stop after marrying Frida .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Skaters Gonna Hate " , it is revealed that Carlos in his alias of Carlos X had a history with Tony Hawk .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Frida Puga - Casagrande Frida Puga - Casagrande ( voiced by Roxana Ortega ) is Ronnie Anne and Bobby 's aunt and Carlos ' wife .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is an avid artist and photographer who becomes emotional over various mundane moments and bursts into tears at the drop of a hat .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In addition , Frida contributes art to The Art Space .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Miss Step " , it is revealed that Frida is an expert at Baile Folklorico .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Her maiden name is named after staff member Miguel Puga .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlota Casagrande Carlota Casagrande ( voiced by Alexa PenaVega ) is the eldest of Carlos and Frida 's children , their only daughter , Rosa and Hector 's granddaughter , and the cousin of Bobby and Ronnie Anne .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is a cheerful , happy - go - lucky admirer of vintage fashion and has a following on social media .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlos " CJ " Casagrande Jr. Carlos " CJ " Casagrande Jr. ( voiced by Jared Kozak ) is the second eldest and the eldest son of Carlos and Frida 's children , Rosa and Hector 's grandson , and the cousin of Bobby and Ronnie Anne .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has Down syndrome and possesses a very sunny disposition .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: CJ loves to play pretend games and likes pirates .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Short Cut " reveals that CJ is good at cutting hair .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlino " Carl " Casagrande Carlino " Carl " Casagrande ( voiced by Alex Cazares ) is the second youngest of Carlos and Frida 's children , Rosa and Hector 's grandson , and the cousin of Bobby and Ronnie Anne .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has a selfish and macho personality and hatches a variety of get - rich - quick schemes , but is ultimately very childish .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carl likes to play with toys , especially trains .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In addition , he also has a crush on Lori much to the dismay of Lori and Bobby .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Slink or Swim " , Carl was revealed to not be able to swim until Bobby taught him in exchange that Carl teaches him how to tie his shoes .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As seen in " Do the Fruit Shake " , Carl is shown to be an expert DJ .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Despite his selfishness , he still really cares about his family .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Carlitos Casagrande Carlitos Casagrande ( voiced by Roxana Ortega up to episode 6 of The Casagrandes , Cristina Milizia from episode 7 of The Casagrandes onward ) is the youngest of Carlos and Frida 's children , Rosa and Hector 's grandson and the cousin of Ronnie Anne .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has noticeably orange hair and a propensity to mimic those around him .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is just beginning to learn how to talk as seen in " Copy Ca n't " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Other Casagrande family members

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lupe Lupe ( voiced by Angélica Aragón ) is the mother of Rosa , the mother - in - law of Hector , the grandmother of Maria and Carlos , and the great - grandmother of Ronnie Anne , Bobby , Carlota , C.J. , Carl and Carlitos , who lives in Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Danny Puga Danny Puga ( voiced by Danny Trejo ) is the father of Frida , the grandfather of Carlota , C.J. , Carl , and Carlos , and the great - uncle of Ronnie and Anne and Bobby .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He works as a stunt performer .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Casagrande family pets The Casagrandes have pets of their own :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sergio ( voiced by Carlos Alazraqui ) is the Casagrande family 's pet scarlet macaw .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He has a sassy personality and acts like an alarm clock .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is named after cartoonist Sergio Aragonés , famous for his work in Mad Magazine .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lalo ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is the Casagrande family 's friendly pet English Mastiff .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Despite his large size , he is easily scared .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In the episode " Perro Malo " , it is revealed that Lalo was adopted as a puppy by Hector , and has a twin brother named Malo .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is named after cartoonist Lalo Alcaraz , author of the comic strip La Cucaracha ; editorial cartoons ; and the show 's cultural consultant , consulting producer , and writer .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Paco ( voiced by Sergio Aragonés ) is a yellow - headed blue parrot who is Lupe 's pet and a " cousin " of Sergio .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He learned English from television and often has to help Lupe with translation .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In the episode " The Golden Curse " , he married a pigeon named Paulina .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Casagrandes Movie shows that Paco and Paulina later adopted numerous Mexican birds as children .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Chang family The Changs are a Chinese American family that arrive in Great Lakes City and moved into Apartment 3A above the Casagrandes ' apartment .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sid Chang Sidney " Sid " Chang ( voiced by Leah Mei Gold ) is the cheerful , happy - go - lucky , energetic and high - spirited 12 - year - old daughter of Stanley and Becca Chang , Adelaide 's older sister , and Ronnie Anne 's best friend and neighbor .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Friended ! with the Casagrandes " , the two of them meet and quickly become best friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sid always wants to try new things .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is also an expert at robotics .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Stanley Chang Stanley Chang ( voiced by Ken Jeong ) is the Chinese father of Sid and Adelaide .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He works as a subway conductor in Great Lakes City 's subway system called the GLART ( short for Great Lakes Area Rapid Transit ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Becca Chang Becca Chang ( voiced by Melissa Joan Hart ) is the mother of Sid and Adelaide and the wife of Stanley .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She works as a zoologist .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " How to Train Your Carl " reveals that Becca is currently working at the Great Lakes City Zoo .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Adelaide Chang Adelaide Chang ( voiced by Lexi Sexton ) is the six - year - old sister of Sid .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sid describes her as a " professional sass bucket . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Adelaide can be emotional as seen in " Croaked " when her pet frog Froggy passed away .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Karate Chops " reveals that Adelaide is an expert at karate and has karate skills that surpass Carl 's .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She also has a love for animals that is comparable to Lana 's love for them .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Froggy 2 Froggy 2 ( vocal effects provided by Dee Bradley Baker ) is a frog who is Adelaide 's pet and the successor of her late pet Froggy .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Breakfast Bot Breakfast Bot ( voiced by Carlos Alazraqui ) is a robot created by Sid Chang who has a toaster for a chest and upper back , a toaster oven for an abdomen and lower back , a spatula for a right hand , a whisk for a left hand , and one wheel instead of legs .

text: This section lists the faculty and students of Royal Woods Elementary School :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Wilbur T. Huggins ( voiced by Stephen Tobolowsky ) is the principal of Royal Woods Elementary School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Agnes Johnson ( voiced by Susanne Blakeslee ) is a fifth - grade teacher at Royal Woods Elementary School who Lincoln and Clyde had as a teacher , until " Schooled ! " when Lincoln and Clyde now attend middle school .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Cheryl Farrell ( voiced by Grey DeLisle ) is the school secretary at Royal Woods Elementary School who speaks with a Southern accent .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Schooled ! " reveals that Cheryl has a younger twin sister named Meryl who looks and talks exactly like her ( except with a few differences ) and works at Royal Woods Middle School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Coach Pacowski ( voiced by Jeff Bennett ) is a gym teacher at Royal Woods Elementary School with a stern and authoritarian personality who has a crush on Agnes Johnson .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Teachers ' Union " , it is revealed that Coach Pacowski enjoys mini - golf , has never left Michigan , and lives on a houseboat with his mother .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Following a failed date with Agnes , he starts to fall in love with Nurse Patti after she patched him up from his obstacle course injuries and found out that they have a common hobby .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Darcy Helmandollar ( voiced by Mariel Sheets ) is a girl who is Lisa 's friend .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She owns a plush toy giraffe named Raffo .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: By the events of " InTODDnito " , Darcy is a little bit taller than Lisa .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Miss Allegra ( voiced by Sabrina Fest in " Community Disservice " , Debi Derryberry in 2020 – present , portrayed by Kate Bergeron in The Really Loud House ) is a first grade teacher .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She had Lana and Lola as students in season four and later gained Lisa as a student in season five .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Morticians Club are a group of goth children that Lucy is co-president of and are fans of The Vampires of Melancholia .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Bertrand ( voiced by James Arnold Taylor ) is a small boy who is the original president of the Morticians Club .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He resigned from his position in " A Grave Mistake " after his father Brad got a job on a party cruise called the S.S. Funtime forcing his family to move from Royal Woods .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " The Loathe Boat " , Bertrand became uncomfortable being on the S.S. Funtime cruise with Brad and his mother Kim causing him to send a message pelican to the Morticians Club to remove him from it during its time on the shores of Lake Eddy .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: After every attempt failed , Lucy helped Bertrand come clean by mentioning how the S.S. Funtime had made him miserable .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As a compromise , Brad and Kim allowed Bertrand to stay with his Aunt Madeline in Royal Woods until they return from Croatia .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Boris ( voiced by Nika Futterman , portrayed by Joshua Gallup in The Really Loud House ) is a tall , thin , and bald - headed member of the Morticians Club who plays the keyboard .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Dante ( voiced by Cristina Pucelli , portrayed by Max Malas in The Really Loud House ) is a short round member of the Morticians Club .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He owns a pet snake .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Haiku ( voiced by Georgie Kidder , portrayed by Hannah Alltmont in The Really Loud House ) is an 8 - year - old ( 9 - year - old season 5 onward ) goth girl who is Lucy 's best friend and co-president of the school 's Morticians Club that Lucy is a part of , originally introduced as one of Lincoln 's dates in " Dance , Dance Resolution " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She has a hairstyle in which some of her hair covers her left eye .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Haiku has a crush on an ostensibly 200 - year - old vampire .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " A Grave Mistake " , she and Lucy become co-presidents of the Morticians Club after Bertrand leaves Royal Woods .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She is named after the poetry form Haiku .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Morpheus ( voiced by Richard Steven Horvitz ) is a tall member of the Morticians Club who wears a blue cape .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He owns a pet crow named Thorn .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Persephone ( voiced by Lara Jill Miller ) is a tall member of the Morticians Club who carries around a parasol .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Norm ( voiced by Jeff Bennett ) is the janitor at Royal Woods Elementary School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He secretly keeps a friendly mutated rat with green eyes and two tails named Cinnamon in the school 's basement because he did not want him to be studied by scientists .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln , Clyde , Stella , Zach , Rusty , and Liam eventually find out by investigating rumors of a ' rat beast ' , but assure Norm they will keep his secret .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Nurse Patti ( voiced by Lara Jill Miller ) is a friendly school nurse at Royal Woods Elementary who is Coach Pacowski 's girlfriend because of their shared mini - golf hobby .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Sasha ( voiced by Marlow Barkley in " The Write Stuff " , Georgie Kidder in " Sand Hassles " , Debi Derryberry in " Wild Goss Chase " , Lucy Rubiner in " Summer Camp : Do n't Lose Your Cool " and " Nobody Puts Baby in a Corral " ) is a fourth grade student who is a member of Royal Woods Elementary School 's writing club .
