text: This section lists the faculty and students of Royal Woods Middle School :

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Principal Ramirez ( voiced by Marisol Nichols , portrayed by Susie Castillo in The Really Loud House ) is the stern yet fair principal of Royal Woods Middle School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: A running gag is that she gets dragged into viewing Lincoln 's slide shows about certain things that he wants to address to her .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The Action News Team is the group of school news in Royal Woods Middle School that is formed by Lincoln , Clyde , and their gang of friends : Liam Hunnicutt ( voiced by Lara Jill Miller , portrayed by Gavin Maddox Bergman in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House ) is Lincoln 's 11 - year - old ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) friend with a bowl cut who speaks in a Southern accent and lives on a farm .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He enjoys loud music , exclaiming that he wants the music " turned up to eleven " , a reference to This Is Spinal Tap .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As of " Schooled ! " , Liam now attends middle school .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Rusty Spokes ( voiced by Wyatt Griswold in 2016 – 2020 , Owen Rivera - Babbey in 2020 – 2021 , Diego Alexander in 2021 – present , portrayed by Nolan Maddox in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House ) is the 11 - year - old ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) talkative member of an unnamed bicycle group who is one of Lincoln 's schoolmates .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Although making fun of Lincoln and his bike in " Hand - Me - Downer " , he later becomes one of Lincoln 's friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Back in Black " , it is revealed that Rusty has a brother named Rocky who has a mutual crush on Lucy .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Pasture Bedtime " , it is revealed that Rusty is allergic to hot sauce .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As of " Schooled ! " , Rusty now attends Royal Woods Middle School and his voice is now deeper .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Stella Zhou ( voiced by Haley Tju , portrayed by Trinity Jo - Li Bliss in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House ) is an 11 - year - old ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) Filipina American girl who moved to Royal Woods .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: She was initially recognized by her bow and hair bun hairstyle in " White Hare " before being introduced in " Be Stella My Heart " no longer sporting a bow and hair bun and of a considerably taller stature .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Lincoln , Clyde , Liam , Rusty , and Zach thought that Stella had a crush on them until she stated that she just wanted to be friends with them , which they did .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Schooled ! " , Stella now attends Royal Woods Middle School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Swimming Fools " , it is revealed that Stella is Principal Ramirez ' neighbor .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Zachary " Zach " Gurdle ( voiced by Jessica DiCicco , portrayed by Mateo Castel in The Really Loud House and A Really Haunted Loud House ) is an 11 - year - old ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) bespectacled red-haired boy who is one of Lincoln 's friends and schoolmates .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is obsessed with conspiracy theories and aliens , and believes the U.S. government is spying on his family .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: According to Lincoln in " Overnight Success " , Zach lives " between a freeway and a circus . "

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: In " Pasture Bedtime " , it is revealed that Zach 's hair is vulnerable to certain hair dyes that cause his hair to fall off temporarily .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: As of " Schooled ! " , Zach now attends middle school .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Boy Jordan ( voiced by Ari Castleton in " Exchange of Heart " , Jessica McKenna in " Frame on You " , " Steeling Thunder " , and " Spy Dames " ) is a student at Royal Woods Elementary School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: By season five , Boy Jordan attends Royal Woods Middle School and takes part in photography .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Chandler McCann ( voiced by Daniel DiVenere ) is one of the most popular children in Royal Woods Elementary School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He attends Royal Woods Middle School as of " Schooled ! " .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Chandler first appeared in " The Waiting Game " and while originally appearing in a minor recurring role from seasons 1 – 4 , Chandler gradually develops into Lincoln 's arch - rival starting from the premiere of Season 5 .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: So far , the episode " Jeers for Fears " has been the only episode in which Chandler showed genuine respect towards Lincoln and Clyde .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Trent ( voiced by Tristian Chase in " Save the Date " , Gunnar Sizemore in " Deal Me Out " , Steele Gagnon in " Jeers for Fears " , Archer Vattano in 2023 – present ) is a boy who is often seen associated with Chandler .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Chef Pat ( voiced by James Arnold Taylor in " Kernal of Truth " , Alex Cazares in 2021 – present ) is the school chef at Royal Woods Middle School who went to Royal Woods High School with Rita when they were friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The food she serves ranges from appetizing to non-appetizing .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Diss the Cook " had Chef Pat serving Lincoln 's big sisters throughout her career with awful lunches because she thought she was n't invited to Rita 's graduation party .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: This was rectified when the graduation party invitation was found in the last library book she used in Royal Woods High School causing Rita to arrange for a re-enactment of her graduation party .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Coach Keck ( voiced by Grey DeLisle , portrayed by Caroline Christopher in The Really Loud House ) is the gym teacher at Royal Woods Middle School .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Frame on You " revealed that Coach Keck is near - sighted and just got some new glasses .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Crikey ( vocal effects provided by Cree Summer ) is a red kangaroo that was accidentally purchased by Coach Keck instead of the costume of a kangaroo mascot costume .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: He is often hyperactive due to the energy drinks he consumes and tends to kick - box anyone .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: The episode " Kanga - Ruse " reveals that Liam trains Crikey for his halftime show .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Girl Jordan ( voiced by Catherine Taber ) is one of Lincoln 's 11 - year - old ( 12 - year - old season 5 onward ) classmates .

source.page_title: List of characters in The Loud House franchise

text: Walter Hartwell White ( also known by his alias Heisenberg ) ( played by Bryan Cranston ) is an overqualified high school chemistry teacher from Albuquerque , New Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After being diagnosed with lung cancer , he starts manufacturing methamphetamine to provide for his family upon his death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Knowing nothing about the drug trade , he enlists the aid of his former student , Jesse Pinkman , to sell the meth he produces .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter 's scientific knowledge and dedication to quality leads him to produce crystal meth that is purer and more potent than any competitors ' .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To avoid the tedious collection of pseudoephedrine required for production , Walter devises an alternative chemical process utilizing methylamine , giving his product a distinctive blue color .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: His methamphetamine , which is given the street name " Blue Sky " , dominates the market , leading to confrontations with established drug makers and dealers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter is initially opposed to the use of violence , but gradually comes to see it as a necessity .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He also comes to find his new status as a drug lord psychologically rewarding , leading him to become increasingly willing to resort to criminal acts such as theft , extortion , money laundering , depraved indifference , and murder .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter 's descent , Macbeth - like , into the criminal underworld unearths immense levels of deeply repressed ambition , rage , resentment , vanity , and an increasing ruthlessness which alienates him from his family and colleagues .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After meeting Saul Goodman , Skyler concocts a plan to feasibly launder Walter 's money through a car wash where he had recently worked part time .

text: The plan is successful , and in seasons 4 and 5 , Skyler launders Walter 's money through the car wash , though she remains deeply unhappy about their situation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the final 2 seasons , she becomes increasingly fearful of Walter given that he is slowly becoming more of a hardened criminal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walter kills Gus Fring , Skyler 's fears are fully realized , and she attempts to distance their children from her and Walter , staging a suicide attempt so that Hank and her sister Marie will temporarily take their children in .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She tells Walter that she will be a complicit partner in whatever capacity so long as their children are not living with them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walter quits the drug business , he and Skyler begin rebuilding their relationship and their family life until Hank discovers Walt is Heisenberg .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When in the episode " Buried " , Skyler 's DEA brother - in - law Hank tells her he is on to Walt but needs her help to provide sufficient evidence to build a successful case , Skyler replies that she needs a lawyer and later tells Walt they should remain quiet .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Hank is killed , she and Walter fight , and he abducts Holly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter uses this as a chance to exonerate Skyler in the eyes of the law , absolving her of any complicity during his drug operations .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is permitted to keep their children ; however , she is told that she must find valuable information for the authorities to use against Walter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the series finale , Walter visits Skyler a final time , admitting to her that his meth business was for him rather than the family ; he provides her with the coordinates of Hank and Steve Gomez 's whereabouts , imploring her to use them as her escape from his ordeal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the episode " Breaking Bad " of Better Call Saul , Skyler is mentioned to have gotten a successful plea deal with the prosecutors .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse Pinkman

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse Bruce Pinkman ( played by Aaron Paul ) is a small - time methamphetamine user , manufacturer , and dealer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In high school , he was an indifferent student in Walter White 's chemistry class .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Now in his mid-20s , Jesse is Walt 's business partner in the meth trade .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse is impulsive , hedonistic , and uneducated beyond high school , but he is financially ambitious and streetwise .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He talks in playful slang , likes to wear garish clothing that follow the latest trends in youth culture , plays video games , listens to rap and rock music , takes recreational drugs , and drives lowriders .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt treats Jesse like a foolish son in constant need of stern correction .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse 's own family kicked him out of their house because of his drug use .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite the friction between them , he and Walt have a deep bond of loyalty .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As a result of his relationship with Walt , Jesse becomes an excellent meth cook , ultimately leading others to exploit him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite his criminal lifestyle , Jesse is far more empathetic than Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is horrified by the brutality at the higher levels of the drug trade particularly during later seasons , but remains involved with Walt out of necessity and loyalty .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is very protective of children ; his desire to keep children out of the violent drug world gives rise to several key events throughout the series .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He wrestles with feelings of guilt about the deaths , all drug - related , of people he has been associated with .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Towards the end of the fifth season he is overwhelmed by guilt and his " blood money . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Realizing how much pain he has caused for money leads him to attempt to give bundles of cash from his final payoff to people he knows and then throw them from his car window onto random lawns and porches .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , Jesse departs for a new life in Alaska .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank Schrader

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Henry R. Schrader ( played by Dean Norris ) is Walt and Skyler 's brother - in - law and Marie 's husband , who works as a U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration ( DEA ) agent .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is involved in investigating a meth dealer known as " Heisenberg " , unaware for over a year that his prey is actually Walter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank has a cavalier exterior , but in reality the dark side of his job affects him more than he cares to admit leading him to suffer from anxiety and post-traumatic stress .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the course of his work , Hank is promoted to El Paso , Texas from Albuquerque for a short time but experiences a traumatic event and moves back to Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite his brashness , Hank is highly competent at his job and cares deeply about his family .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank is eventually promoted to Assistant Special Agent in Charge of the DEA in Albuquerque but is still determined to solve the " Heisenberg " case , which ultimately leads to his demise .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank also had guest appearances in the fifth season of Better Call Saul .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Domingo " Krazy - 8 " Molina is arrested , Jimmy McGill bargains with Hank to make Domingo his confidential informant , which allows Lalo Salamanca to feed information on Gus Fring 's operations to the DEA .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie Schrader

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie Schrader ( née Lambert ) ( played by Betsy Brandt ) is Skyler 's sister , Hank 's wife , and Walt 's sister - in - law .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie works as a radiologic technologist .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She does not hesitate to offer advice to others but often fails to practice what she preaches .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She shoplifts compulsively — apparently a manifest symptom of kleptomania — a behavior for which she sees a therapist .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She appears self - centered and shallow but cares deeply for her husband and her sister 's family .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nearly all of her household and clothing items are shades of the color purple .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 3 , Marie becomes a major source of comfort and support for Hank , when The Cousins shoot and nearly kill him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: With Walt and Skyler 's help , she arranges for Hank to undergo an aggressive physical therapy program their insurance does not cover .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Hank stubbornly decides to stay at the hospital , claiming he is completely disabled , she refuses to give up on him and gives him a handjob to prove he still has feeling below the waist .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When he returns home , however , Hank remains cold and brash , despite her attempts to make him comfortable , and Marie spirals back into kleptomania .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Once Hank progresses with the case , his relationship with Marie improves again .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt and Skyler have marital problems , she takes in their children for a couple of days at Skyler 's request while they work things out .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the final season , Hank tells Marie about Walter 's criminal activities , and Marie confronts Skyler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When she learns Skyler knew the truth before Hank 's shooting , Marie slaps her sister and storms out of the room .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She tries to take Holly with her , but Hank commands her to return the baby .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She then urges Hank to capture Walter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie helps Hank try to stop Walt and Skyler , but Walt foils them when he makes a DVD framing and blackmailing Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie eagerly offers to help Hank when Jesse agrees to confess about Walt 's crimes .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She initially does not know that Hank is dead and reconciles with Skyler on the condition that the latter tells Walt Jr. everything .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie learns that Hank is missing when Walt kidnaps Holly and eventually she receives confirmation he has died .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is later seen two months later in her house , warning Skyler to watch out for Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marie reappears in the series finale of Better Call Saul , present as a witness in the trial of Saul Goodman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Prior to the trial , she castigates Saul for his role in Walt 's crimes and the deaths of Hank and Steve , but Saul claims to have been coerced to work for Walt under threat of death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul later reverses course during the trial by admitting he willingly helped Walt expand his criminal empire .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter White Jr.

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter Hartwell ( Flynn ) White Jr. ( played by RJ Mitte ) is Walter and Skyler 's teenage son and Holly 's older brother .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He has cerebral palsy , as manifested in speech difficulties and impaired motor control , for which he uses crutches ( which Mitte , who has a milder variation of cerebral palsy , does not require ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Angered by his parents ' constant fighting , Walter Jr. tries to establish an independent identity , insisting on being called Flynn and asking his best friend Louis to teach him how to drive .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When he discovers that Walt has cancer , Walter Jr. changes his attitude and sets up a website , " www.savewalterwhite.com " , which requests and collects donations in an effort to help pay for Walt 's cancer treatment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt 's lawyer , Saul Goodman , arranges for a wave of fictional " donations " drawn from Walter 's drug money , in order to launder it and also make Walter Jr. 's efforts appear successful .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Skyler and Walt separate , Walter Jr. , given no explanation by either parent , only sees that his mother has ( from his point of view ) inexplicably thrown his terminally ill father out of the house , and he takes his father 's side and stops answering to the name Flynn .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Always being " late to the game " ( as defined by Mitte on an episode of Talking Bad ) , Walter Jr. remains oblivious to his father 's drug trade life until " Ozymandias " , when Marie , confident that Walt is in Hank 's custody , forces Skyler to reveal the whole truth to her son .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Upon learning of his father 's connection with Hank 's death , Walter Jr. mistakenly concludes that Walt killed Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Feeling betrayed , Jr. calls 911 when Walt fends off Skyler 's knife attack , thus forcing Walt to leave and eventually end up on the most wanted list .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Granite State " , Walt attempts to talk to him over the phone and have him retrieve $ 100,000 that Walt planned to send to Louis 's address ; however , Walter Jr. ( by this time , officially registered in school records as Flynn White ) angrily refuses and hangs up .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Felina " , Walt visits Skyler for the final time , and watches from afar as Flynn / Walter Jr. returns to the safe house from school .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus Fring

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gustavo Fring ( played by Giancarlo Esposito ) is the Chilean - born proprietor of Los Pollos Hermanos , a highly successful fried chicken restaurant chain .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also a public booster for the local DEA office and a member of the hospital board .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite outward appearances , Gus is a major drug kingpin initially affiliated with the Mexican drug cartel in Ciudad Juárez , who use his restaurants as a front for methamphetamine distribution throughout the American southwest , supported by Los Pollos ' corporate owners , Madrigal Electromotive .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Like Walter White , Gus is a criminal who " hides in plain sight " , using his anti-drug philanthropy to conceal his true nature .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As shown in flashback in the Breaking Bad episode " Hermanos " , Gus and his business / romantic partner Maximino Arciniega had approached the cartel with the offer to produce and sell meth for the cartel , but Don Eladio had Hector Salamanca kill Max as punishment for going behind Eladio 's back , then forced Gus to participate in distributing cartel cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Emigrating to the United States , Gus appeared acquiescent but secretly plotted to exact revenge and eliminate his dependence on the cartel by producing his own meth via a " super lab " hidden beneath an industrial laundry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the events of Better Call Saul , Gus allies with Mike when Mike finds his own family at risk from the Salamancas , and turns Nacho into a mole within the Salamanca organization after discovering that Nacho caused Hector to have a stroke by secretly replacing Hector 's heart medication with fakes .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Wanting to be the agent of Hector 's death , Gus pays for Hector 's recovery but only to the point where he has recovered his mental faculties and can move his right index finger .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus seizes more of the drug trade from the Salamancas , but when the cartel sends Lalo to replace Hector , Gus is forced to make sacrifices to protect the developing meth lab and Nacho 's status as his mole .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus arranges an assassination attempt on Lalo , but Lalo secretly survives and begins hunting for evidence of Gus 's culpability .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus realizes Lalo is alive and takes extreme security measures to protect himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He ultimately kills Lalo in a shootout at the lab 's construction site , and has him ( and Howard Hamlin ) buried beneath the lab 's foundation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: By the events of Breaking Bad , Gus produces and distributes meth instead of cocaine , but still seeks independence from the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He has completed the super lab and plans for Gale to be his cook , but when he discovers the superior quality of Walter 's blue meth , he hires Walter and reluctantly allows Jesse to serve as Walter 's assistant .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This leads to a series of confrontations and fallouts that culminate with Jesse killing Gale at Walter 's instigation , saving Walter 's life by making him irreplaceable to Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The relationship between Jesse and Walter falters as a result of Jesse 's guilt , enabling Gus to draw Jesse in as an ally .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus offers Jesse 's services to the cartel as part of a ruse to kill Eladio and eliminate the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Knowing his life is still at risk because Jesse has proved to be nearly as capable as Walter in the lab , Walter goads Jesse into providing information Walter uses to set a trap for Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During a visit with Hector at his nursing home , Gus plans to finally end Hector 's life , but realizes too late that he has been tricked .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector rings the bell attached to his wheelchair repeatedly to trigger the bomb Walter planted , which kills Hector , Tyrus , and Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul Goodman

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul Goodman ( played by Bob Odenkirk ) , byname of James Morgan ( Jimmy ) McGill , is a sleazy and unscrupulous lawyer who acts as Walter and Jesse 's attorney and provides some of the series ' comic relief .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He uses the name " Saul Goodman " because he thinks his clients feel more confident with a Jewish lawyer ; this name is also homophonous with the expression " [ it] 's all good , man . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dressing in flashy suits , Saul maintains extensive connections within the criminal underworld and serves as a go-between connecting drug distributors , fixers , impersonators , and other criminals - for - hire .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite his flamboyant appearance and mannerisms — punctuated by his outrageously low - budget TV commercials — Saul is a highly competent lawyer who is able to solve problems and find loopholes in order to protect his clients .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also reluctant to be associated with violence or murder .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul 's origins are explored in Better Call Saul , the events of which begin about six years before Breaking Bad .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Originally a con man nicknamed " Slippin ' Jimmy " , he is arrested in Chicago after a prank gone wrong , but his older brother Chuck McGill , a partner in an Albuquerque law firm , obtains his release on the condition that Jimmy obtain legitimate employment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy works in the mailroom of Chuck 's firm , and Chuck 's legal success inspires Jimmy to become an attorney himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck does not consider Jimmy a " real " lawyer and surreptitiously conspires to prevent him from joining his firm , relegating Jimmy to low - level cases and public defender work .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Chuck 's death and Jimmy 's yearlong suspension of his law license , Jimmy returns to practice under the " Saul Goodman " alias , drawing on the criminal clientele he has gained through his side business of selling disposable cell phones .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the period of his law license suspension , Jimmy 's side business causes him to inadvertently become involved in the Albuquerque drug business as an associate of Mike and a legal representative for the Salamanca family .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: By the time of Breaking Bad , Saul has established an office in a strip mall and advertises across the city .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walter and Jesse begin producing meth , Saul introduces them to Gus as a potential buyer for their product .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He subsequently helps Walter and Skyler launder their drug money , and provides legal assistance for Jesse and his drug - dealing friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Hank discovers Walter 's identity as Heisenberg , Saul uses the " disappearing " services of Ed Galbraith to relocate to Omaha , Nebraska under the name Gene Takavić ( as shown in flash - forwards in Better Call Saul ) , where he runs a Cinnabon store while remaining paranoid that someone from his past might identify him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene is eventually identified by a relocated taxi cab driver who remembers his Saul Goodman ads , but Saul keeps the man quiet by offering to make him wealthy using a con scheme .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul is eventually caught by the authorities and imprisoned for 86 years in a federal prison , but after finally accepting himself as Jimmy McGill and atoning for his role in the deaths of Chuck , Howard , and others .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike Ehrmantraut

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Michael Ehrmantraut ( played by Jonathan Banks ) is a former Philadelphia police officer who works for Gus — and , on occasion , Saul — as a private investigator , head of security , cleaner , and hit man .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Better Call Saul episode " Gloves Off " , it is implied Mike is a Marine Corps veteran of the Vietnam War .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While in Philadelphia , he married and had a son , Matt , who later had his own family : wife Stacey and daughter Kaylee .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike got caught up in crooked activities within the Philadelphia police , and , after Matt joined the force , Matt hesitated when two crooked cops approached him , so they killed him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Matt 's funeral , Mike murdered the two cops , then fled to Albuquerque to be near Stacey and Kaylee .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He took a job as a parking - lot attendant at the local courthouse and also performed for - hire criminal jobs on the side .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , Mike becomes Jimmy 's associate after Jimmy helps cover for him when Philadelphia officers investigating the deaths of the two cops Mike killed learn of Mike 's whereabouts .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Through one of his side - jobs , Mike also becomes involved with Nacho .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho asks Mike to help eliminate an increasingly unstable Tuco from the Salamanca organization , but Mike instead engineers Tuco 's long - term arrest by faking a confrontation in front of police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector suspects Mike , so Mike attempts to bring police attention to the Salamanca drug trade .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When this effort fails , Mike plans to assassinate Hector but is stopped by Gus , who wants to be the one to decide when Hector dies , and offers Mike a position within his organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike oversees the construction of the " super - lab " led by Werner Ziegler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Werner escapes and inadvertently reveals some details about the lab to Lalo Salamanca , Gus orders Werner killed to protect the secret , and Mike shoots Werner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike is depressed afterwards , until Gus offers him a larger role in helping gain revenge against the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Knowing Nacho is operating as Gus 's mole in the Salamanca organization , Mike works to keep Lalo off Gus 's trail and saves Jimmy from a cartel assassination attempt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike remains as Gus 's trusted associate by the time of Breaking Bad , helping to keep Walter and Jesse in line after Jesse kills Gale , and coming up with a plan to drive a rift between Walter and Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eventually , Gus trusts Jesse enough to bring him and Mike to Mexico as part of Gus 's plan to kill Don Eladio and other cartel members .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike is critically wounded and forced to stay in Mexico to heal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During this time , Walter convinces Jesse to help Walter get revenge on Gus , and Jesse 's information enables Walter to lure Gus into a fatal trap .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike hears of Gus 's death and races back to Albuquerque to furiously confront Walter and Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike reminds them that , to maintain secrecy , Gus had been discreetly paying off several members of Gus 's organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter starts a new meth production system with Jesse and Mike as full partners , and Mike uses part of his share to continue to pay off the members of Gus 's old organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Todd kills a child during a methylamine heist , Mike and Jesse sell their share of the methylamine , but Mike promises to use part of his profit to continue paying off Gus 's old crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The DEA connects Mike to Heisenberg and , before Mike can flee , Walter tries to obtain the names of Gus 's old organization from Mike so Walter can have them killed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike refuses and chides Walter , leading Walter to shoot him , but before Mike dies Walter says he realized too late he could have gotten the names from Lydia .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lydia Rodarte - Quayle

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lydia Rodarte - Quayle ( played by Laura Fraser ) is an executive of Madrigal Electromotive GmbH , working out of the company 's office in Houston , Texas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lydia , portrayed as a very nervous and somewhat troubled character , is a partner in Gus 's drug activities , and Gus often works directly through her to secretly secure Madrigal 's resources for his needs .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During Better Call Saul , she helps Gus arrange for Mike to become a Madrigal security consultant as a cover to launder the money Mike stole from the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Mike takes his job seriously , Lydia complains to Gus , but Gus assures her Mike can be trusted .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Lalo later arrives and interferes in Gus 's operations , Gus reports to Lydia and Peter Schuler , the head of Madrigal 's food division , about Lalo stalling the construction of his superlab , but assures them he has a plan to deal with Lalo .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Within Breaking Bad , Lydia continues to discreetly provide chemicals to Gus for Walt 's meth production in Gus 's superlab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Gus 's death and the destruction of the lab , Walt establishes a new meth production line with Jesse and Mike , with Lydia providing the chemicals .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The DEA links Gus to Madrigal , and nervous that she will be exposed , Lydia asks Mike to kill 11 co-conspirators who were part of Gus 's organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike refuses , so Lydia pays one of the co-conspirators to eliminate Mike along with the other 10 on the list , but Mike kills the hitman first , discovers Lydia 's role , and blackmails her to continue to provide the methylamine for Walt 's operation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The DEA continue to investigate Madrigal , and Lydia discovers they are tracking her methylamine shipments to Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She provides Walt with information on a railroad tanker car shipment of methylamine , which would provide Walt with enough material to make millions of dollars ' worth of meth for sale to Lydia 's contacts in the Czech Republic .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt , Mike , and Jesse enlist Todd to help steal the methylamine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the theft , they are observed by a young boy , whom Todd kills .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike and Jesse then decide to sell their portion of the methylamine to Walt and leave the business , with Mike using a portion of his profits to continue paying the members of Gus 's organization for their silence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When the DEA connects Mike to Gus , Walt tries to get Mike to provide the names of the individuals he is paying , but Mike refuses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt shoots Mike , then realizes he could have asked Lydia for the names .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike dies , and Lydia later provides the names to Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt then pays Jack to eliminate the individuals Mike was paying .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt eventually sells the remaining methylamine to Declan and leaves the drug business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Todd initially works as Declan 's meth cook , but when Declan fires Todd , the replacement is not as good , and Lydia 's Czech customers are dissatisfied .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise
